1) Clarify retention and deletion windows in the Order Form (we can accept a customer-defined retention up to X days, but need explicit language).
2) Confirm controller/processor mapping — if MedicoRE designates Redwood as processor for feature X, we need the Order Form exhibit to reflect that.
3) Fallback deployment: operationally we can offer an EU-only private cluster (Dedicated) as a fallback. I need Pricing to confirm the monthly delta for a guaranteed capacity reservation.
4) Evidence: Legal requested a copy of your SCCs exhibit (thanks for the extract). If you can share the full SCCs exhibit or the specific clause references we can map them to our Appendix.

Proposed timeline:
- Today: internal redline pass + pricing delta estimate (Ben)
- Mon 09/28: legal tie-out + final DPA redline acceptance (Laura)
- Tue 09/29: MedicoRE sign-off or counter-sign via DocuSign

If that timeline looks tight for you, tell us the latest acceptable sign date. We want to avoid last-minute procurement escalations.

Elena / team,

Thanks for the draft. A few legal coordination items before we can accept the DPA redlines: 

- Section 4 (Subprocessors): we can accept your proposed carve-in for the analytics subprocessor provided we keep a 30-day notice and the ability to object on material grounds.
- Section 6 (Transfers & SCCs): we will map your SCC references to Redwood's SCC Exhibit and include a cross-reference table in the Order Form. Please send the clause numbers rather than a summary so the mapping is precise.
- Transfer annex fallback language: we prefer a two-stage fallback: (1) temporary data localization measures + additional contractual safeguards for up to 60 days, (2) Dedicated EU deployment only after mutual confirmation and a signed amendment to the Order Form. That preserves continuity while protecting both parties.

Please also provide any internal MedicoRE playbook requirements (audit logs, data subject request routing) so we can confirm scope in the DPA. We will produce a tracked-redline and a clean copy for DocuSign once the mapping is complete.
